title: Exams and Timetable
facts: Exam types: midterm + coursework + practical/lab (if applicable) + final
Final exam: 50% of grade | Duration: 1hr per credit (3cr=3hrs)
Project: no written exam; Coursework 40% + Oral/presentation 60%; committee of 2 faculty (1 external min) + supervisor
Coursework 50% includes: quizzes, exercises, theory, practical, research, attendance
Timetable: published in annual calendar at www.nub.edu.eg
Missed midterm WITH excuse: submit to dean within 1wk→makeup arranged with dept head
Missed midterm WITHOUT excuse: zero for midterm component
Missed final WITH excuse (within 1wk): grade=Incomplete(I); must complete within 2wks after last exam of semester; requires instructor confirmation of potential pass + attendance within limit
Missed final WITHOUT excuse: zero for final component; grade calculated accordingly
Semester results: approved by College Council | Graduation results: approved by University Council

faq.a: Submit excuse to dean within 1wk→makeup scheduled. No excuse→zero
With excuse(1wk): grade=I; complete within 2wks post-semester. No excuse→zero on final
No written exam; oral+report+practical to 2-faculty committee (1 external); oral/report=60%, coursework=40%
Valid excuse + instructor confirms potential pass + absence ≤25%
